metadata.article_title: Pledge where pawnor has only a limited interest.

article.title: Pledge where pawnor has only a limited interest.
article.content: Where a person pledges goods in which he has only a limited interest, the pledge is valid to the extent of that interest.
article.html:
179Pledge where pawnor has only a limited interest.

Section 179 · Chapter IX · Bailments of Pledges · page 43 of the Act

Where a person pledges goods in which he has only a limited interest, the pledge is valid to the extent of that interest.
